first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A yellow low-slung sports car in the foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large dark-red rear wing, and four bright red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A distant white low-slung vehicle on the racetrack ahead of Vehicle A, very small in the image.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: A gray paved racetrack extending from the foreground into the distance, curving right and uphill in the initial section, then tending to straighten.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: A large expanse of low-texture blue-gray sky above the terrain and tree canopies.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: Low red-and-white alternating curbs repeatedly arranged along the edge line of the racetrack surface.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The source ID corresponds to the barriers on both sides; at frame 0, the left side is a solid red-and-white segmented wall, and the right side has blue advertising cladding.

entities.name: metal racetrack guardrail
entities.identification: A silver-gray roadside guardrail composed of parallel horizontal metal panels.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: A roadside fence composed of repeated gray posts and low-contrast mesh.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: Dense areas of dark-green trees around the outside of the racetrack, with tree-canopy outlines of varying heights.

entities.name: distant mountain
entities.identification: Undulating distant ridges ranging from gray-green to gray-blue, with part of a light-gray mountain face exposed in the last frame.

entities.name: racetrack sign and display screen
entities.identification: The collection of racetrack markings corresponding to the source ID; blue advertising cladding and a white billboard on the slope are visible in this clip.

entities.name: overpass crossing diagonally above the racetrack
entities.identification: A gray bridge crossing diagonally across the upper part of the image, with forked diagonal supports and a thin railing along the bridge edge.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: Low green ground cover outside the racetrack and on the slopes.
